Ibn Humayd narrated to us, saying: Mihran narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Juwaybir, from al-Dahhak, regarding ﴿al-Mu'min﴾, he said: the one who confirms (the truth).

Yunus narrated to me, saying: Ibn Wahb informed us, saying: Ibn Zayd said, regarding His saying ﴿al-Mu'min﴾: "The Mu'min is the one who confirms, the certain one. People believed in their Lord, so He named them believers, and the Generous Lord believed in them, and by their faith He confirmed them, that He be named by that name."

* *

And His saying: ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾

The people of interpretation differed in its interpretation. Some of them said: al-Muhaymin is the Witness.

Mention of those who said that:

'Ali narrated to me, saying: Abu Salih narrated to us, saying: Mu'awiyah narrated to me, from 'Ali, from Ibn 'Abbas, regarding His saying ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾, he said: the Witness; and he said once more: the Trustworthy.

Muhammad ibn 'Amr narrated to me, saying: Abu 'Asim narrated to us, saying: 'Isa narrated to us, and al-Harith narrated to me, saying: al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Warqa' narrated to us, all from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding His saying ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾, he said: the Witness.

Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, regarding His saying ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾, he said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent down a Book and bore witness to it.

Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾, he said: the Witness over it.

Others said: al-Muhaymin: the Trustworthy.

Mention of those who said that:

Ibn Humayd narrated to us, saying: Mihran narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Juwaybir, from al-Dahhak, regarding ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾: the Trustworthy.

Others said: ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾: the Confirmer.

Mention of those who said that:

Yunus narrated to me, saying: Ibn Wahb informed us, saying: Ibn Zayd said, regarding His saying ﴿al-Muhaymin﴾, he said: the confirmer of everything that has been related. He recited ﴿and a guardian over it﴾ and said: the Qur'an confirms what came before it of the Books, and Allah confirms everything He has related about what passed of the world, what remains, and what He has related about the Hereafter.

I have already explained which of these sayings is closest to correctness earlier, in Surah al-Ma'idah, with the reasons that indicate its soundness, so that suffices in place of repeating it here.

* *

And His saying: ﴿al-'Aziz﴾

: the Mighty in His retribution against those among His enemies whom He avenges.

As related:

Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, regarding ﴿al-'Aziz﴾, i.e., in His vengeance when He takes vengeance.

Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding ﴿al-'Aziz﴾: in His vengeance when He takes vengeance.

* *

And His saying: ﴿al-Jabbar﴾

Meaning: the one who sets right the affairs of His creation, directing them in what is good for them. Qatadah used to say: He compelled His creation to what He wills of His command.

Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding ﴿al-Jabbar﴾, he said: He compelled His creation to what He wills.

* *

And His saying: ﴿al-Mutakabbir﴾

It has been said: it means that He is exalted above every evil.

Mention of those who said that:

Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatadah, regarding ﴿al-Mutakabbir﴾, he said: He is exalted above every evil.

Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Qatadah, the like of it.

Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, saying: Ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, saying: Abu Raja' informed us, saying: a man narrated to me, from Jabir ibn Zayd, who said: Indeed the Greatest Name of Allah is Allah. Did you not hear Him say: ﴿He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, He is the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Source of Peace, the Granter of Security, the Guardian, the Mighty, the Compeller, the Majestic. Glorified is Allah above what they associate with Him﴾? He says: a declaration of Allah's transcendence and His being free from the association of the polytheists with Him.

Commentary of al-Tabari (Jami al-Bayan) on surah 59, verse 24:

The interpretation of His, the Exalted's, words: ﴿He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Fashioner. To Him belong the most beautiful names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.﴾

He, the Exalted, says: He is the worshipped Creator, other than whom there is no deity worthy of worship and no creator besides Him. The Originator (al-Bari') is the One who brought creation into being, producing them by His power. The Fashioner (al-Musawwir) shapes His creation as He wills, and in whatever form He wills.

* *

His words: ﴿To Him belong the most beautiful names﴾

He, the Exalted, says: To Allah belong the most beautiful names, and these are the names by which Allah has named Himself, which He mentioned in these two verses. ﴿Whatever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him﴾ means: everything that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Him and prostrates to Him, willingly and unwillingly. ﴿And He is the Mighty﴾ means: He is severe in retribution against His enemies. ﴿The Wise﴾ means: in His management of His creation and His disposition of them in what brings about their welfare.

End of the commentary on Surat al-Hashr.
